tasks.label: 🧪 Deep Clean: Dry Run (preflight only)
tasks.command:
set -e; \
        echo '🔎 Preflight checks…'; \
        git fetch --all --tags; \
        if ! git diff --quiet; then echo '❌ Uncommitted changes. Commit/stash first.'; exit 1; fi; \
        echo '✅ Working tree clean'; \
        command -v git-filter-repo >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'ℹ️  Note: git-filter-repo not found (will install during full run)'; \
        echo '✅ Preflight complete. Ready for full deep clean.'

tasks.label: 💾 Deep Clean: Create Backups (tag + mirror)
tasks.command:
set -e; \
        TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); \
        TAG=pre-deepclean-$TS; \
        echo "🏷️  Creating safety tag $TAG"; \
        git fetch --all --tags; \
        git tag "$TAG"; \
        echo '📦 Creating mirror backup ../brain-swarm-backup.mirror'; \
        rm -rf ../brain-swarm-backup.mirror; \
        git clone --mirror . ../brain-swarm-backup.mirror; \
        echo "✅ Backup ready. Restore tag: $TAG"

tasks.label: 🧹 Deep Clean: Run git filter-repo
tasks.command:
set -e; \
        echo '📦 Ensuring git-filter-repo is available…'; \
        python3 -m pip install --user git-filter-repo >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; \
        command -v git-filter-repo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '❌ git-filter-repo not found. Install manually then retry.'; exit 1; }; \
        echo '🧽 Rewriting history to remove artifacts…'; \
        git filter-repo \
          --invert-paths \
          --path venv \
          --path __pycache__ \
          --path .pytest_cache \
          --path .mypy_cache \
          --path .coverage \
          --path-glob '*.pyc' \
          --path-glob '*.pyo' \
          --path-glob 'Thumbs.db' \
          --path-glob '.DS_Store'; \
        echo '✅ History rewritten locally.'

tasks.label: 🚀 Deep Clean: Force-push rewritten branches
tasks.command:
set -e; \
        echo '⬆️  Pushing rewritten history with --force-with-lease'; \
        for BR in main develop develop-v3; do \
          if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/heads/$BR; then \
            echo " → $BR"; \
            git push --force-with-lease origin $BR; \
          fi; \
        done; \
        echo '🏷️  Syncing tags'; \
        git push --force-with-lease --tags origin; \
        echo '✅ Remote updated. Re-enable branch protections if disabled.'

tasks.label: 🔎 Deep Clean: Post-checks
tasks.command:
set -e; \
        echo '📏 Repo size:'; git count-objects -vH; \
        echo '🧪 Scanning history for removed paths (should print nothing)…'; \
        if git log --name-only --pretty='' | grep -E '^(venv/|__pycache__/|.pytest_cache/)' ; then \
          echo '⚠️  Some entries still found above. Review filter-repo paths.'; exit 1; \
        else \
          echo '✅ No removed artifacts found in history.'; \
        fi

tasks.label: ↩️ Deep Clean: Revert to backup tag (manual tag needed)
tasks.command:
set -e; \
        TAG=${REVERT_TAG:-pre-deepclean}; \
        echo "⚠️  Reverting current branch to tag: $TAG"; \
        git fetch --all --tags; \
        git reset --hard "$TAG"; \
        echo '🔁 Force-pushing the revert'; \
        CUR=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); \
        git push --force-with-lease origin "$CUR"; \
        echo '✅ Reverted current branch to backup tag.'
